title: Desktop host and update profiles
summary: Electron, Tauri, Wails and Avalonia native pickers and fixed OS credential slots, bounded IPC, verified update state machines and opt-in local release profiles with explicit platform limits.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0: 9 portable boundary/file-IO/injected-vault/update-consent tests passed; no Electron GUI or real OS vault used.
Linux x86_64, Go 1.27.2: 5 portable tests and their race run passed with real local TLS, ECDSA verification and final-consent replacement of a synthetic temporary file; no executable launched.
Linux x86_64, Rust 1.99.0: 3 standalone title/token/file validation tests passed. Tauri CLI 2.12.1 exported original SVG icons; Cargo lock resolution succeeded; native Tauri compilation not run.
Linux x86_64 cross-compiling Windows amd64, Go 1.27.2: actual Wails host built with CGO_ENABLED=0 and tags desktop,production. No Windows runtime executed.
commands: go -C wails test app.go app_test.go delivery.go delivery_test.go
notes: Desktop GUI, native secure stores, .NET/Avalonia runtime, Tauri native build, platform signing and installed update acceptance were not run locally. This pack remains experimental.

Electron/Tauri/Wails/Velopack release scripts require trusted feed and appropriate release-owner signing inputs; all produce local artifacts and never publish. Native gates fail when prerequisites are absent.

Wails automatic executable update packaging supports Windows/Linux x64/arm64; macOS signed-bundle replacement is deliberately unsupported. Avalonia Velopack packaging targets Windows x64; other OS delivery needs a separate installed profile.
Included icons are original SVG-derived PNG/ICO exports. Wails frontend/dist is original source; generated binding/SDK/runtime trees and binaries are excluded.
